error.exiftool.title: exiftool not found
error.exiftool.detail:
GeoPhotos needs exiftool to read and write coordinates.

• Install for GeoPhotos — downloads the official exiftool from exiftool.org (about 11 MB), checks it and puts it next to GeoPhotos.exe.
• Install from the website — opens exiftool.org; after installing, start GeoPhotos again.
• Choose exiftool.exe — if exiftool is already on the computer (exiftool.exe together with its folder exiftool_files).

help.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
help.doubleClick: In the strip: show the photo on the map (centred; a group opens up)

help.open: Open a folder (choose any photo in it): the strip starts afresh

help.action.dropOnTrack: Drag photos onto a track in the strip
help.dropOnTrack: Each gets its place on the track at the time it was taken; those outside the track do not change
help.action.dragMarker: Drag a marker on the map
help.dragMarker: All shown photos at that point move; the marker of one of several selected photos — all selected ones go there
help.boxSelect: Select the photos in the rectangle (instead of the selection)
help.action.dropOnMark: Drop photos next to the found place mark
help.dropOnMark: They land exactly on the mark
help.dropFromExplorer: A folder opens (the strip starts afresh); files are added to the strip
help.markNoCoords: Status bar: photos without coordinates — the ones still to place; a placed photo leaves the list
help.markTrack: A track (GPX, KML, KMZ, FIT, TCX, GeoJSON): a line on the map; Space — its summary and profile
